# Agisilaos Papadogiannis: live research tools

> Three finance research tools. Two are recomputed from current public data and publish their
> figures as data files; the third is a calculator that works from the numbers it is given. This
> file says where each tool's own guide is. It holds no figures.

Written for AI agents and other programs. People should start at https://apapadogiannis.github.io/

## Tools

- Crypto Observatory: Bitcoin's required return for market, concentration and mortality risk,
  recomputed every month, with what Bitcoin delivered against it and a census of cryptoasset deaths.
  Guide: https://apapadogiannis.github.io/crypto-observatory/llms.txt

- Covered-Call Monitor: total returns, written calls, structured notes and net flows of US
  covered-call, buy-write and premium-income funds, recomputed every quarter from SEC filings.
  Guide: https://apapadogiannis.github.io/covered-call-monitor/llms.txt

- Dual-Risk DCF Calculator: splits the gap between two views of an asset into the discount rate and
  the forecast, from your own numbers; a page and an MCP server.
  Guide: https://apapadogiannis.github.io/dual-risk-calculator/llms.txt

Read a tool's guide before its data: it states what the figures are, how to read them, what they
cannot answer and how to cite them.

## The whole account

The index of every tool, paper and replication package, with the tools' latest figures and one
sentence on what each paper finds:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apapadogiannis/apapadogiannis/main/llms.txt

One skill for an AI assistant covers all of it:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apapadogiannis/apapadogiannis/main/skill/SKILL.md
